typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		SBSB_ID as string,
		MEME_LAST_NAME as string,
		MEME_FIRST_NAME as string,
		MEME_MID_INIT as string,
		MEME_SEX as string,
		MEME_BIRTH_DT as timestamp,
		MEPE_EFF_DT as timestamp,
		MEPE_TERM_DT as timestamp,
		SGSG_MCTR_TYPE as string,
		PDPD_ID as string,
		MEPE_ELIG_IND as string,
		CSPI_ID as string,
		MEME_WRK_PHONE as string,
		LOADDATE as timestamp,
		ExitInFile as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	format: 'table',
	staged:false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource derive(dc_MemberSourceID = $v_memberSourceID,
		dc_CreateUserID = $v_createUserID) ~> DerivedColumn
DerivedColumn derive(dc_MemberSourceID = dc_MemberSourceID) ~> PlaceHolderNewMemberInsertedcount
PlaceHolderNewMemberInsertedcount sink(input(
		{} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		{} = _FirstName)) ~> OLEDBCommand
